svg.aria-label: The flz CLI starting a relay, sending to it, adding a plugin and listening

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.text: # Start a controller in the background; a Python runner serves the echo factory from another terminal.
[flezha] no RELEASE_COOKIE provisioned; using the node-local cookie in /tmp/flezha-demo/flezha/storage/app/state/cookie.
[flezha] That value is this node's alone. A cluster provisions RELEASE_COOKIE with the same value on every node.
RUNNER PID NODE CONNECTED AT LATE
# Start a relay from the echo factory and talk to it
# Plug in a file writer: every output now also lands in a file
writer file_sink bound: my_echo runs on: flezha@127.0.0.1
# Listen live while prices are sent from elsewhere
